admission.justification: A durable page written during authoring would outlive a failed attempt, or an abandoned draft would hold the store forever.

applicability: Frame authoring attempts and their reclamation.
conditions: The attempt holds a lease and was admitted with an explicit working directory.
exclusions: A published ready revision, which is retained until superseded.

evidence: A4-checks/finish-controls.json: explicit-authoring-folder-and-verified-durable-import; probes.json: active-publication-archive-control; focused F12 and cancellation

statement: The frame lifecycle must distinguish and preserve active drafts, reclaim only abandoned drafts and retain bounded authoring failure/cancellation outcomes without replacing valid ready output.
